einzeiler: Analysis of the congressional races and early 2028 presidential contenders.
kurzfassung: Jon sits down with Democratic strategist David Plouffe to analyze the current races for the Senate and House. They discuss the new roster of early primary states and their underlying political dynamics. Additionally, they provide an early assessment of potential 2028 contenders, including Kamala Harris, AOC, and Jon Ossoff.
stichpunkte: Assessment of the race for the Senate and House
Discussion on the new roster of early primary states
Political dynamics at play in the primary states
Early handicapping of rumored 2028 presidential contenders
Analysis of potential candidates including Kamala Harris, AOC, and Jon Ossoff
beschreibung:
Jon sits down with legendary Democratic strategist David Plouffe to assess the race for the Senate and House and — why not? — look forward to 2028. The two talk through the new roster of early primary states and the political dynamics at play in each, and then do some (very) early handicapping of the rumored '28 contenders, from Kamala Harris to AOC and Jon Ossoff.
